reason: Most of the 'unbilled' work it would find is stuff I do for free on purpose to keep long-standing clients happy, so a report telling me to go and charge for it isn't something I'd act on. Even with them doing the exports with me, it's still a call, a DPA and handing client contracts to a company I've never heard of, all to tell me something I already half know.
objection: I won't send uplift emails to clients I've had for years over a few hours here and a licence there. The money conversation is the part I hate, and nicer wording doesn't make it less awkward or less of a risk to the relationship.
would_change_my_mind: A peer MSP owner I trust telling me it found real leakage they'd genuinely missed, like licences we're paying for and never recharging, rather than goodwill work, and that raising it didn't cost them a client.
